summary: A 21-image v10 package was prepared without changing the v9 structures or frozen checkpoints; O-H interval count is review-only, moderate C-C excursions are warnings, and only severe C-C compression or extension remains a hard stop.

payload.objective: Run and review the complete frozen-MatRIS ordinary ML-NEB path for Fe(110) C2HO*+H* -> C2H2O*+*, followed by AQCat25 exact fixed-path audit only after a complete primary path returns.
current_evidence: The v10 package contains the exact same 21 structure hashes as v9 and retains the frozen MatRIS and AQCat25 checkpoints.
O-H interval image count is review evidence and is not a transient or final hard gate; O-H backtracking remains graded-warning evidence.

Collision, non-finite model output, periodic-branch failure, adjacent RMSD above 0.75 A, and a single movable-atom step above 1.20 A remain hard safety failures.
Local no-model geometry preflight, Python compilation, the complete dual-model executor test file, and Ruff checks passed.
At 2026-08-29T01:01:22+08:00 all four MZ73 RTX 4090 GPUs had active processes; free memory was approximately 15.99, 8.93, 2.52, and 18.94 GiB on GPUs 0-3 respectively.

payload.submission_boundary: The v10 package is prepared locally only. No upload, GPU resubmission, MatRIS fine-tuning, VASP, micro-NEB, Dimer, TS acceptance, or barrier action is authorized by this preparation event.

The returned path is reviewed for convergence, chemistry, periodic continuity, reaction-coordinate coverage, peak structure, and dual-model comparison before any VASP proposal.
